title: shadcn-ui CLI writes a component into the source tree
intent: Exercises a real installer CLI that fetches, transforms and writes files inside the VFS. This is the first fixture that depends on writes working under a tool, not under our own test code.
source: stackblitz-conformance: shadcn-ui (public 'Runtime Test Cases for AI Agents' suite, adapted into our own scenario)
knownLimits: The CLI prompts unless flags suppress it; a prompted run must be answered by configuration, never by waiting for a timeout.
